slides.title: Jets and drones over a Wollo town
Fighting in Wuchale
slides.body: Residents told Wazema that fighter jets and drones were used in Wuchale, Ambasel district, as federal forces fought Fano on Nov 3. Homes and businesses were reportedly set on fire.

slides.title: Town changes hands
slides.body: Residents said government forces regained control of Wuchale that afternoon. Clashes continued in Robit, Wurgessa and Girana.

slides.title: Civilians caught in between
slides.body: Wazema says days of operations disrupted transport and affected civilians. Casualties and damage have not been independently verified.

slides.title: Tigray fronts active too
slides.body: Residents reported clashes in Central Tigray (Adet, Bizet, May-Kinetal) and Northwestern Tigray (Shiraro, Egela). Both the TPF and the TPLF claim control of Bizet.

slides.title: Protect civilians in Wollo and Tigray.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
